value.behaviour: Restore keeps a valid element pageId and sanitizes pages, activePageId and pageViewports; legacy data restores onto the default page.
rules: 1. restoreElementWithProperties: after the legacy deletes, `if (typeof ret.pageId !== "string" || !ret.pageId) delete ret.pageId;` (the element spread already carries a valid pageId through).

2. restoreAppState, after fontTopPicks: nextAppState.pages = restorePages(nextAppState.pages); nextAppState.activePageId = resolveActivePageId(nextAppState.pages, nextAppState.activePageId); nextAppState.pageViewports = only entries whose key is a page id in nextAppState.pages and whose value has finite scrollX, scrollY and a zoom with finite value (normalized with getNormalizedZoom), else {}.
3. Never drop elements whose pageId is unknown: they resolve to the home page at runtime (FR-18).

sites.rule: Add rule 1 with a comment `// keep a valid page membership, drop malformed ones (unknown ids fall back to the home page at runtime)`.
Add rule 2, inlined here as a short loop over Object.entries of the supplied pageViewports.

value.behaviour: Search matches text and frames on every page; focusing a match on another page switches to that page first.
rules: 1. handleSearch reads app.scene.getNonDeletedElementsAllPages() instead of getNonDeletedElements().

2. In the focus effect, when match exists and app.scene.getElementPageId(match.element) !== app.state.activePageId, call app.actionManager.executeAction(actionSwitchPage, "ui", pageId) and return; the effect dependency list gains app.state.activePageId so it re-runs and scrolls once the page is active.
3. Highlights still render only for the active page (interactiveScene looks matches up in the active map).

value.behaviour: Tab bar listing the drawing's pages with create, switch, inline rename, keyboard/drag reorder and delete.
rules: 1. Props: { appState: UIAppState; actionManager: ActionManager }. Read pages via getNonDeletedPages(appState.pages) (memoized on appState.pages); the active id via resolveActivePageId.

3. Each page: <button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected data-testid={`page-tab-${page.id}`} className={clsx("PageTabs__tab", { "PageTabs__tab--active": active })}>; label = page.name || t("pages.defaultName", { number: position + 1 }); click executes actionSwitchPage with page.id.

4. Rename (not in view mode): onDoubleClick replaces the tab label with <input aria-label={t("pages.renameInputLabel")} data-testid="page-rename-input"> prefilled with the label and focused; Enter or blur executes actionRenamePage { pageId, name: value }, Escape cancels; the action ignores empty/whitespace names.

5. Reorder (not in view mode): on a focused tab Alt+ArrowLeft / Alt+ArrowRight executes actionReorderPage { pageId, toPosition: position - 1 / position + 1 } (clamped); tabs are draggable and onDrop executes actionReorderPage with the drop target's position.
6. Create: a <button data-testid="page-create" aria-label={t("pages.createPage")} title> "+" button that executes actionCreatePage; hidden in view mode.

7. Delete: the active tab gets a sibling <button data-testid="page-delete" aria-label={t("pages.deletePage")}> executing actionDeletePage with the page id; rendered only when more than one page exists and not in view mode.
8. Render nothing when appState.zenModeEnabled. No document/window globals.

2. .PageTabs: display flex, gap 0.25rem, overflow-x auto, pointer-events all, max-width 60vw. .PageTabs__tab: compact button with ellipsis for long names (max-width 12rem). .PageTabs__tab--active: primary-coloured bottom border and bold text. Focus-visible outlines stay visible.
